summary: FG Merger II Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a Third Amendment to its merger agreement with BOXABL Inc. The amendment revises lock-up agreements: 50% of company lock-up shares release after six months if the surviving pubco's common shares hit $12 for 20 of 30 trading days; the rest release at 13 months regardless; all shares release early if the price reaches $20 intraday. Sponsor lock-up shares release 50% at the earlier of 12 months or $12 for 20 of 30 days; the rest at 12 months; early release at $20. The deal remains subject to shareholder approval and regulatory conditions. Watch for shareholder vote timing and any further delay risk.
